props.text: 166 now, would have turned into a decent loss. Always important to trust your gut and understand when the setup is invalidated. The only reason I didn't full TP on Friday was because I thought we were maybe going to reclaim our box / area of interest. When I saw the Sunday overnight action immediately fully retrace all the Friday bullish move, I knew it was weak. But alas that's the last update on it for now. Just a good reminder to accept when the trade is no longer going as you expect and to cut and wait for the next trade rather than rely on hope.
